displayName: CADP-AI-T5-R2 transport-neutral external readout adapter source and tests
priorAbsorption: T5-R2 adds a pure transport-neutral adapter contract over the accepted T5-R1 helpers. Independent review repaired the omitted candidate-metadata input and incorrect redaction/allowlist composition, removed ambient ordinal state from fallback receipt identity, and added deterministic malformed-input coverage. No authentication, transport registration, credential, provider call, mutation, or external invocation authority exists.

findings.summary: Worker implementation omitted candidate metadata from the exact API and probed an empty allowlist record instead of composing redaction and allowlist validation over caller candidate metadata.
findings.nextAction: Retain reviewer-added composition and deterministic malformed-input regressions; require a fresh governed packet for authentication or transport runtime.

findings.summary: CADP-AI-T5-R2A separated unique contract-source ownership from shareable package-root references, so R2 package-root exports are now independently fixture-backed and drift-attributed without weakening contractPath uniqueness.
findings.nextAction: Retain the shared-root positive proof, duplicate-contract negative, and exact T5-R2 missing-export attribution regression; authentication and transport runtime remain separately deferred.

nextScanRecommendation: Re-scan only if a separately authorized authentication, transport, or checker-maintenance tranche changes these surfaces.
